entities.name: Yōji Kuri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yōji Kuri  was a Japanese cartoonist and independent filmmaker. An influential figure in Japanese independent animation, he was the unofficial leader and most prolific of the "Animation Association of Three"  collective who kick-started the renaissance of modern-styled, independently made, adult-aimed animation in early 1960s Japan.
